Container.Name: nzbfast
Container.Overview: Speed-focused Usenet (NZB) downloader written in Rust. Single small binary, low memory, saturates fast lines with a handful of connections. Verifies articles while they download, so most jobs finish with no separate verify pass; repair and unpack run only when needed. Web dashboard on port 6789 with a SABnzbd-compatible API — works with Sonarr, Radarr and friends out of the box. Drop .nzb files in the watch folder or add them from the dashboard. Set an API key (NZBFAST_APIKEY, shown under Advanced) before connecting *arr apps.

Config.Name: Watch
Config.Description: Drop an .nzb file here to queue it automatically.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns downloaded files (99 = nobody, the Unraid default).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns downloaded files (100 = users, the Unraid default).

Config.Name: API Key
Config.Description: API key for Sonarr/Radarr and other automation. Leave empty to set one later in the dashboard settings.
